component.name: OpenVPN
component.summary: openvpn3 connection state and profile switching from the COSMIC panel

description.p: A COSMIC panel applet that shows openvpn3 connection state at a glance and lets you connect, disconnect, and switch profiles from its menu. Importing a .ovpn file happens from the same menu.
Two windows open only when needed: the credential prompt openvpn3 requires mid-connect, and a read-only session log after a failed connect. No credential, one-time code, or passphrase is ever stored.

ul.li: Connection state in the panel, driven by openvpn3 status signals.
Connect, disconnect, and switch profiles from the menu, with one session at a time.
Credential prompts for passwords, one-time codes, and private-key passphrases.
Import, rename, and delete profiles without a terminal.
A read-only log for diagnosing a failed connect.
